sites.title: Title
sites.errorNoTitle: A site must have a title.
navigation.label: Label
navigation.errorMissingTarget: A page or URL link needs its target.
siteSettingGroup.browsingIntro: How lists of items look when visitors browse.
siteSettingGroup.searchIntro: What the site's search box looks through.
siteSettingGroup.itemPagesIntro: What visitors see on a single item or media page.
siteSettingGroup.languageIntro: The site's language and how it treats values in other languages.
siteSettingGroup.navigationIntro: The menus, bars and browser tab around every page.
siteSettingGroup.advancedIntro: Linked data and site boundaries. Most sites keep the defaults.
siteSetting.paginationPerPageHelp: How many entries a browse or search page lists before it adds page links. Empty uses the installation setting.
siteSetting.browseDefaultsPublicItemsHel: The order visitors see items in when they browse all items.
siteSetting.browseHeadingPropertyTermHel: Which field to show as each item's title on browse pages. Usually Title.
siteSetting.browseBodyPropertyTermHelp: Which field to show below each item's title on browse pages. Default shows the description.
siteSetting.browseAttachedItemsHelp: Browse previews and search results list only items that appear in a block on one of this site's pages.
siteSetting.searchTypeHelp: Whether the search box looks through this site only or through every site.
siteSetting.searchResourceNamesHelp: Which kinds of content appear in this site's search results.
siteSetting.attachmentLinkTypeHelp: Where a visitor lands after clicking an image in a media block: the item page, the media page or the file itself.
siteSetting.showAttachedPages: List pages that feature the item
siteSetting.showAttachedPagesHelp: Item pages end with links to the site pages where the item appears.
siteSetting.propertyLabelInformationHelp: Item pages show the vocabulary or the technical term beside each field name.
siteSetting.iiifViewerThemeHelp: A light or dark background for the IIIF viewer, in blocks and on item pages.
siteSetting.iiifViewerSidebarHelp: Opens the viewer with its sidebar of contents and details showing.
siteSetting.localeHelp: The language of the site's own words, such as buttons, menus and dates.
siteSetting.filterLocaleValues: Only show values in the site language
siteSetting.filterLocaleValuesHelp: Item pages hide values tagged with another language. Values with no language tag still show.
siteSetting.showLocaleLabelHelp: Item pages show a short language code, such as en, beside each value that has one.
siteSetting.installationTitleHelp: Shown after the page title in the browser tab and in bookmarks.
siteSetting.subnavDisplayHelp: Whether a page shows the links to its child pages above its content. Automatic shows them when the page has children.
siteSetting.showUserBar: Admin bar on the public site
siteSetting.showUserBarHelp: A bar at the top of public pages with links back to the admin.
siteSetting.showPagePaginationHelp: Site pages end with links to the previous and next page in the navigation.
siteSetting.faviconHelp: The small image in the browser tab and in bookmarks. Pick one of your assets or upload an image.
siteSetting.disableJsonldEmbedHelp: Item pages stop embedding JSON-LD, the machine-readable copy that search engines and harvesters read.
siteSetting.excludeResourcesNotInSite: Hide links to items outside this site
siteSetting.excludeResourcesNotInSiteHel: Item pages drop values that link to an item or item set that is not in this site.
siteSettingSort.title: Title
resourcePage.title: Resource pages
resourcePage.hint: The blocks an item, item set or media page shows, in order.
resourcePage.empty: No blocks. This page shows only its heading.
asset.empty: No assets are stored yet. Upload one.
query.countError: The match count could not be read.
route.invalidSiteId: "{param}" is not a valid site id.
route.invalidPageId: "{param}" is not a valid page id.
editor.previewUnavailable: Live preview is not available yet.
editor.previewError: The preview could not be rendered: {message}
template.name: Template name
template.managerHint: Templates saved from this site, available when you add a page.
siteHub.unknownLinkType: A module added this link type. Its settings are kept as stored.
siteHub.emptyMenuNote: With no links, the public site shows one link to its homepage.
siteHub.unsavedConfirm: The navigation has unsaved changes. Leave and lose them?
siteHub.picked: Picked up {label}. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.
siteHub.treeHelp: Drag a link to move it: drop it on the top or bottom of a row to place it there, or on the middle to nest it. With the keyboard, press Space on a handle, then the arrow keys. Left and Right change the level.
layoutHelp.pageTitle: The title of the page as a heading.
layoutHelp.media: Media files from items, embedded or as thumbnails.
layoutHelp.browsePreview: A list of items, sets or media in this site that match a search.
layoutHelp.listOfSites: Links to the other sites on this installation.
layoutHelp.tableOfContents: Links to the pages under this one in the navigation.
layoutHelp.lineBreak: A divider or extra space between blocks.
layoutHelp.itemWithMetadata: An item with its media and its metadata.
layoutHelp.pageDateTime: When the page was created or last changed.
layoutHelp.blockGroup: Wraps the blocks that follow it in one group.
layoutHelp.iiifPresentation: A IIIF manifest or collection in a viewer.
layoutHelp.iiifImage: One IIIF image in a zoomable viewer.
layoutHelp.asset: Uploaded images, each with an optional link and caption.
layoutHelp.html: Formatted text: headings, lists, links and quotes.
layoutHelp.listOfPages: A list of chosen pages, nested as you arrange them.
layoutHelp.oembed: Content embedded from a URL, such as a video.
romekaHelp.hero: A large banner with a heading, text and a background image.
query.siteNoMatch: No items in this site match, so the block shows nothing. A browse preview lists only the items that belong to the site: add items on the site's Items page.
siteItems.detachHelp: Detaching a set keeps its items on the site. Items created in the set later no longer join.
siteItems.publicOnlyHelp: The public site never shows private items.
siteItems.searchPreview: {matched} items match, {added} not on this site yet.
siteItems.pickPreview: {count} picked, {added} not on this site yet.
siteItems.empty: This site has no items yet.
siteItems.syncSets: An item created in one of this site’s item sets joins the site. Editing an item never adds it, so items you remove stay removed.
siteItems.syncEvery: Every item created from now on joins this site, because the site has no item sets. Editing an item never adds it, so items you remove stay removed.
siteItems.syncSearch: An item created from now on joins this site when it matches the site’s saved search. Editing an item never adds it, so items you remove stay removed.
siteItems.noSetsYet: This site has no item sets. Pick a whole set above to add one.
siteItems.searchOnce: This adds the matching items once. It does not change which new items join the site.
siteItems.replaceConfirm: Replace the site’s items with these {matched}? Items that leave the site: {removed}. Items that join: {added}.
itemPicker.help: Arrow keys move, Space picks, the Right arrow shows details, the Left arrow goes to the sources.
itemPicker.error: The items could not be read.
itemPicker.peekEmpty: Move to an item to see its details.
itemPicker.trayEmpty: Nothing is picked yet. Space or a click picks an item.
itemPicker.trayHelp: Drag a pick to move it, or use Alt and the arrow keys.
